title: the-hollow-skips-only-the-instrument
intention: The hollow skips a file under proofs/ only when it is part of the ticket's instrument (a proof whose PROVES names the ticket, or a proofs/ module such a proof imports); any other proof file the build wrote is the build's subject, so the hollow reverts it and watches the instruments' teeth.
why: Measured 2026-10-05: 580ad3b46cd0 (the trees tool's proof measures only the tool, a RULE 1 fix) moved two checks out of one proof into another; its build wrote only proofs/ files, so `cairn test --hollow` skipped both as instruments, read nothing, and clearance refused PROVED with [hollow_nothing_measured] and sent it to FIXME. The trees proof was the build's subject, not its instrument: the librarian proof watching it was. Every encapsulation row that sits in a proof (most of the ~89 standing) is fixed by a proof-only build, so each would dead-end the same way.
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass) and RULE 1 (encapsulation): fixing an encapsulation row that sits in a proof is a proof-only build, and today the hollow can never measure one, so every such fix dead-ends at PROVED. The fix widens what the hollow measures; it softens nothing.
how: In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, _classify takes the ticket's instrument set: the proofs proven_by returns that declare a PROVES entry for the ticket, plus every proofs/ module they import (AST, transitively; e.g. test_design_sha imports test_rehearsal, test_call_time_binding imports proofs/fixtures) and returns SKIP_INSTRUMENT for a proofs/ path only when it is in that set; every other proofs/ path is measured like source. The docstring's refusal (1) is restated as 'the instrument', with the measured case. A proof in the tester's own proofs/ shows: a build whose only writes_to is a non-instrument proof gets that file reverted and its tooth watched; an instrument file in writes_to is still skipped; a build writing only instruments still reads hollow_nothing_measured.
falsifier: RED if after the build (1) measure() over a scratch ticket whose writes_to holds a proofs/ file that is neither a proven_by proof nor imported by one skips it as SKIP_INSTRUMENT instead of reverting it; (2) a proven_by proof, or a proofs/ module a proven_by proof imports, in writes_to is reverted; (3) a run whose writes_to holds only instrument files stops raising/reading nothing measured; (4) test_hollow.py, test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py or test_the_hollow_measures_the_repaired_build.py goes red. Horizon: 580ad3b46cd0's hollow retaken after PROVED measures cairn/devices/librarian/tools/trees/proofs/test_trees_is_a_published_tool.py load-bearing. WRONG INTENT if a non-instrument proof's revert reds an instrument tooth for a reason other than the build being reverted.
watchme: none, because the hollow reading is itself sealed on every validation it measures (evidence.hollow, read by clearance.hollow_lacks at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py), so every future proof-only build's PROVED is the watch
children: none, because the change is one function and its three call sites inside cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py plus one new proof
questions: none, because open-155ed994d17b's answer ('the gate stays hard', CairnCommons/questions/open-155ed994d17b.json) is kept, and the hollow module's own docstring states the reason for the skip as 'reverting the instrument', which this ticket makes literal
builder_notes: WHICH function? hollow.py _classify(rel) gains a keyword `instrument: frozenset[str] = frozenset()` and returns SKIP_INSTRUMENT for a proofs/ path only when rel is in it; WHICH callers? the three in hollow.py (build_anchor line 251, the measure loop lines 756 and 762); build_anchor gains an `instrument` keyword it passes through. WHERE is the set built? a new function `instrument_set(proofs, repo_root)` in hollow.py: proofs plus the AST import closure restricted to files under a proofs/ directory that exist in the repo. ORDER in measure(): proofs = proven_by(...) moves above build_anchor. WHICH proof? new cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py on scratch repos in the pattern of test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py. Decision lines carry the rest.

D1: SETTLED: Create cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py with exactly this content. Its PROVES maps falsifier clauses 1-4 to teeth 1-4. Measured at HEAD before the build (2026-10-05): tooth 1 RED (the subject proof other/proofs/test_other.py is in skipped with SKIP_INSTRUMENT), tooth 2 RED (measured is {} because all three files are skipped), tooth 3 GREEN (a build of only the instrument and its helper, subject already clean, reads 'measured nothing' and verdict red). Tooth 4 runs the three standing hollow proofs and is green at HEAD:
"""Teeth for ticket 763379e32e3b — the hollow skips only the instrument.

MEASURED 2026-10-05 on 580ad3b46cd0 (a RULE 1 fix: two checks moved out of the trees tool's
proof into a new librarian proof). Its build wrote only files under proofs/, so
``cairn test --hollow`` skipped both as instruments, measured nothing, and clearance refused
PROVED with [hollow_nothing_measured]. But the trees proof was the build's SUBJECT: the
instrument was the librarian proof watching it. The skip's own reason — "reverting the
instrument makes the reading meaningless" — is true only of the instrument.

THE RULE THESE TEETH HOLD. A file under proofs/ is skipped as an instrument only when it is one
of the ticket's proven_by proofs or a proofs/ module one of them imports (transitively). Any
other proofs/ file the build wrote is reverted and its teeth watched, like source. A build that
writes only the instrument still measures nothing (open-155ed994d17b: the gate stays hard).

Every fixture is a scratch repo with its own journal and decompose berth, the pattern of
test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py. The fixture instrument reads its subject
proof as TEXT, never by import, the way 580ad3b46cd0's proof reads the trees proof.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
sys.path.insert(0, str(_REPO_ROOT))

PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 2700  # three standing hollow proofs run inside tooth 4, each up to 900s

from cairn.devices.tester.hollow import SKIP_INSTRUMENT, measure  # noqa: E402
from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch import git_env, scratch_dir  # noqa: E402
from cairn.tools.proof_coverage.proof_coverage import print_teeth_main  # noqa: E402

PROVES = {
    "763379e32e3b": {
        "1": "test_a_proof_the_build_wrote_that_is_not_the_instrument_is_measured",
        "2": "test_the_instrument_and_what_it_imports_are_still_skipped",
        "3": "test_a_build_of_only_the_instrument_still_measures_nothing",
        "4": "test_the_standing_hollow_proofs_stay_green",
    },
}

FIXTURE = "f1x7763379e3"
TOOTH = "test_the_subject_proof_is_clean"
INSTRUMENT = "proofs/test_fixture.py"
HELPER = "proofs/helper.py"
SUBJECT = "other/proofs/test_other.py"

_HELPER_SRC = 'DIRTY = "REACHES_INTO_THE_HOLDER"\n'

_PROOF_SRC = '''\
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from proofs.helper import DIRTY

PROVES = {"%s": {"1": "%s"}}

def %s():
    p = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "%s"
    return p.is_file() and DIRTY not in p.read_text()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ok = %s()
    print(("ok" if ok else "FAIL") + " %s")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
''' % (FIXTURE, TOOTH, TOOTH, SUBJECT, TOOTH, TOOTH)

_SUBJECT_DIRTY = "def test_other():\n    assert True  # REACHES_INTO_THE_HOLDER\n"
_SUBJECT_CLEAN = "def test_other():\n    assert True\n"

_ENV = {**git_env(), "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME": "fixture", "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL": "f@x",
        "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME": "fixture", "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL": "f@x"}


def _git(repo, *args, at=None):
    env = dict(_ENV)
    if at:
        env.update(GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=at, GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=at)
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)


def _fixture(build: dict, writes_to: list[str], subject0: str = _SUBJECT_DIRTY) -> tuple[Path, Path, Path, dict]:
    """A scratch repo whose instrument (proofs/test_fixture.py, importing proofs/helper.py)
    stands before BUILDME, then one build commit naming the ticket writes ``build``."""
    tmp = scratch_dir("cairn-hollowsubj-")
    repo, commons, berths = tmp / "repo", tmp / "commons", tmp / "berths"
    for d in (repo / "proofs", repo / "other" / "proofs", commons / "tickets"):
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
    _git(repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    (repo / INSTRUMENT).write_text(_PROOF_SRC)
    (repo / HELPER).write_text(_HELPER_SRC)
    (repo / SUBJECT).write_text(subject0)
    _git(repo, "add", "-A")
    _git(repo, "commit", "-qm", "unrelated: c0", at="2020-01-01T00:00:00")
    shas = {"c0": _git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()}
    for rel, text in build.items():
        (repo / rel).write_text(text)
    _git(repo, "add", "-A")
    _git(repo, "commit", "-qm", f"{FIXTURE}: build", at="2020-01-02T00:00:00")
    shas["build"] = _git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    entries = [{"ticket": FIXTURE, "direction": "forward", "actor": "fixture",
                "at": at, "from": frm, "to": to, "proven_by": INSTRUMENT}
               for at, frm, to in (("2020-01-01T12:00:00", "TICKETME", "BUILDME"),
                                   ("2020-01-02T12:00:00", "BUILDME", "PROVEME"))]
    (repo / "history.json").write_text(json.dumps({"entries": entries}))
    berth = berths / "0" / "packets" / f"decompose-20200101T000000-{FIXTURE}.json"
    berth.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    berth.write_text(json.dumps({"ticket": FIXTURE, "stage": "decompose",
                                 "sub_problems": [{"what": "the build", "kind": "build",
                                                   "writes_to": writes_to}]}))
    (commons / "tickets" / f"{FIXTURE}-fixture.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id": FIXTURE}))
    return repo, commons, berths, shas


def _measure(repo, commons, berths):
    return measure(FIXTURE, repo_root=repo, commons=commons, berths_root=berths, timeout=60)


def _skips(f: dict) -> dict:
    return {s["file"]: s["why"] for s in f["skipped"]}


def test_a_proof_the_build_wrote_that_is_not_the_instrument_is_measured():
    """580ad3b46cd0's shape: the build cleans a proof that no crossing names and the instrument
    does not import. The hollow reverts it, and the instrument's tooth reds."""
    repo, commons, berths, c = _fixture({SUBJECT: _SUBJECT_CLEAN}, [SUBJECT])
    f = _measure(repo, commons, berths)
    assert _skips(f).get(SUBJECT) != SKIP_INSTRUMENT, ("skipped as the instrument", f["skipped"])
    assert f["measured"].get(SUBJECT) == [TOOTH], (f["measured"], f["skipped"], f["reasons"])
    assert f["commit"] == c["c0"], ("anchored at", f["commit"], c)


def test_the_instrument_and_what_it_imports_are_still_skipped():
    """The proven_by proof and the proofs/ module it imports are the instrument: listed in
    writes_to beside the subject, both are skipped and the subject is still measured."""
    repo, commons, berths, _ = _fixture(
        {SUBJECT: _SUBJECT_CLEAN, INSTRUMENT: _PROOF_SRC + "# touched\n",
         HELPER: _HELPER_SRC + "# touched\n"},
        [SUBJECT, INSTRUMENT, HELPER])
    f = _measure(repo, commons, berths)
    skips = _skips(f)
    assert skips.get(INSTRUMENT) == SKIP_INSTRUMENT, skips
    assert skips.get(HELPER) == SKIP_INSTRUMENT, skips
    assert f["measured"].get(SUBJECT) == [TOOTH], (f["measured"], skips)


def test_a_build_of_only_the_instrument_still_measures_nothing():
    """open-155ed994d17b: the gate stays hard. A build that wrote only the instrument and its
    import is not measured, and the run says it measured nothing."""
    repo, commons, berths, _ = _fixture(
        {INSTRUMENT: _PROOF_SRC + "# touched\n", HELPER: _HELPER_SRC + "# touched\n"},
        [INSTRUMENT, HELPER], subject0=_SUBJECT_CLEAN)
    f = _measure(repo, commons, berths)
    assert not f["measured"], f["measured"]
    assert any("measured nothing" in r for r in f["reasons"]), f["reasons"]
    assert f["verdict"] == "red", f["verdict"]


def test_the_standing_hollow_proofs_stay_green():
    """The anchor rules (479f75cc0917, e08c996f939c) and the hollow's own proof hold."""
    for rel in ("cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py",
                "cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py",
                "cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_measures_the_repaired_build.py"):
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(_REPO_ROOT / rel)], capture_output=True,
                           text=True, timeout=900, cwd=_REPO_ROOT)
        assert r.returncode == 0, (rel, r.stdout[-1500:], r.stderr[-1500:])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(print_teeth_main(__file__))

D2: SETTLED: The whole code change is in cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py and is exactly what this script does when run from the cairn root with 'python3 build_subj.py'. Each sub() asserts its old text occurs exactly once, so a drifted file fails loudly instead of half-applying. Summary: (a) the module docstring's refusal (1) names the instrument as the ticket's own proofs plus the proofs/ modules they import; (b) build_anchor gains keyword instrument: frozenset[str] = frozenset() and passes it to _classify; (c) _classify(rel, *, instrument=frozenset()) returns SKIP_INSTRUMENT for a proofs/ path only when rel is in instrument; (d) new _module_files and instrument_set(proofs, repo_root) after proven_by; (e) measure() computes instrument = instrument_set(proven_by_since_buildme(tid, roots) or [], repo_root) BEFORE build_anchor (the non-raising reader, so a ticket with no BUILDME is still refused by build_anchor naming BUILDME, which test_hollow.py's test_a_run_that_could_not_be_measured_says_so_instead_of_passing holds; a first trial that moved proven_by above the anchor redded it), passes instrument to build_anchor, leaves proofs = proven_by(ticket, roots) where it stood after _expand_dirs, and both _classify calls in the per-file loop pass instrument=instrument. SKIP_INSTRUMENT's text is unchanged, so test_hollow.py's equality checks on it hold. The script, verbatim:
"""763379e32e3b build: the hollow skips only the instrument. Run from the cairn root."""
from pathlib import Path

H = Path("cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py")
s = H.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def sub(old: str, new: str) -> None:
    global s
    assert s.count(old) == 1, ("expected exactly one", old[:80], s.count(old))
    s = s.replace(old, new)


# (a) docstring refusal (1): the instrument is the ticket's own proofs, not every proofs/ file.
sub("""  1. **A file under ``proofs/``.** Reverting the instrument makes the reading meaningless — the
     reverted proof either errors out or simply no longer contains the teeth, so every declared
     tooth reads "red" and the check passes trivially.""",
    """  1. **The instrument: a proof this ticket's crossings name, or a ``proofs/`` module one of
     them imports.** Reverting the instrument makes the reading meaningless — the
     reverted proof either errors out or simply no longer contains the teeth, so every declared
     tooth reads "red" and the check passes trivially. Any OTHER file under ``proofs/`` the
     build wrote is the build's subject and is measured like source (ticket 763379e32e3b,
     measured on 580ad3b46cd0: its build moved two checks out of another component's proof,
     every file it wrote sat under ``proofs/``, and the run measured nothing).""")

# (b) build_anchor takes the instrument set and filters build commits through it.
sub("def build_anchor(ticket: dict, files: list[str], *, roots: dict, repo_root: Path) -> dict:",
    "def build_anchor(ticket: dict, files: list[str], *, roots: dict, repo_root: Path,\n"
    "                 instrument: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> dict:")
sub("    builds = _build_commits(tid, [f for f in files if _classify(f) is None], repo_root)",
    "    builds = _build_commits(tid, [f for f in files if _classify(f, instrument=instrument) is None],\n"

# (c) _classify skips a proofs/ path only when it is in the instrument set.
sub('''def _classify(rel: str) -> str | None:

# (d) instrument_set, placed right after proven_by.
sub('''    return seen

    '''    return seen


def _module_files(name: str, repo_root: Path, here: Path) -> list[str]:
    """The repo files a dotted module name can resolve to, from the repo root or from the
    importing file's own directory (a proof that puts its directory on sys.path)."""
    out = []
    parts = [x for x in name.split(".") if x]
    if not parts:
        return out
    for base in (Path(repo_root), here):
        p = base.joinpath(*parts)
        for f in (p.parent / (p.name + ".py"), p / "__init__.py"):
            if f.is_file():
                rel = _inside(str(f.resolve()), repo_root)
                if not Path(rel).is_absolute():
                    out.append(rel)
    return out


def instrument_set(proofs: list[str], repo_root: Path) -> frozenset[str]:
    """THE TICKET'S INSTRUMENT: its proven_by proofs, plus every file under ``proofs/`` they
    import, transitively (ticket 763379e32e3b). Only these are skipped as the instrument; any
    other ``proofs/`` file the build wrote is reverted and watched like source.

    The import closure is part of the instrument because reverting a helper the proof imports
    breaks the proof the same way reverting the proof does. Measured 2026-10-05: proofs import
    bus/proofs/bus_proof_echo, proof_coverage/proofs/fixtures and rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal.
    Read by AST from the files at HEAD; an import by string the AST cannot resolve is missed.
    """
    import ast
    root = Path(repo_root)
    seen: set[str] = set()
    todo = [_inside(p, root) for p in proofs]
    while todo:
        rel = todo.pop()
        if rel in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(rel)
        path = root / rel
        try:
            tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, SyntaxError, ValueError):
            continue
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            names: list[str] = []
            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                names = [a.name for a in node.names]
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
                mod = node.module or ""
                if node.level:
                    pkg = path.parent
                    for _ in range(node.level - 1):
                        pkg = pkg.parent
                    try:
                        prefix = ".".join(pkg.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve()).parts)
                    except ValueError:
                        continue
                    mod = ".".join(x for x in (prefix, mod) if x)
                names = [mod] + [f"{mod}.{a.name}" if mod else a.name for a in node.names]
            for name in names:
                for f in _module_files(name, root, path.parent):
                    if "proofs" in Path(f).parts and f not in seen:
                        todo.append(f)
    return frozenset(seen)


def _inside(f: str, repo_root: Path) -> str:''')

# (e) measure(): the instrument is known before the anchor, and passed to every _classify.

    proofs = proven_by(ticket, roots)
''')
sub("        why = _classify(rel)\n", "        why = _classify(rel, instrument=instrument)\n")
sub("            elif succ in measured or succ in moved or _classify(succ) is not None:",
    "            elif succ in measured or succ in moved or _classify(succ, instrument=instrument) is not None:")

H.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
print("applied", H)

D3: SETTLED: The instrument_set algorithm. Seeds are the proven_by_since_buildme paths (the same list proven_by returns) normalized by _inside. Each file is ast.parse'd from the working tree (HEAD), never from the anchor commit. For ast.Import every alias name is a candidate; for ast.ImportFrom the candidates are the module and module.name for each alias, and a relative import (level > 0) is resolved against the importing file's package directory. A candidate dotted name resolves to <base>/<a>/<b>.py or <base>/<a>/<b>/__init__.py, with base the repo root and then the importing file's own directory. Only resolved files that exist inside the repo and have 'proofs' in their path parts join the set; a file that will not read or parse adds nothing more. Seeds are always in the set. Measured before the build: for ticket 9579a6f9cec6 (the live fixture of test_hollow.py) both writes_to proofs, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_diagnostic.py and cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble.py, are proven_by proofs, so that run's skips are unchanged.

D4: SETTLED: Order and mechanics. (1) Seal the proof red: 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 2700 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py' (PROOF_TIMEOUT_S is 2700 because tooth 4 runs three proofs of up to 900s each). The seal writes cairn/devices/tester/validations/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.json, appends to cairn/devices/tester/history.json and rewrites cairn/devices/tester/state.json, and journals in cairn/.artifact-journal.jsonl. Commit the proof and those files in cairn, in the background and never wrapped in timeout. (2) Run D2's script. Then 'python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py' reports '4 passed' (about 13 minutes, most of it tooth 4); this was measured 2026-10-05 in a detached worktree of HEAD with D2 applied. (3) Seal green: 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 2700 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_skips_only_the_instrument.py', and reseal the three standing proofs (cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py, cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_anchor_ignores_instrument_commits.py and cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_hollow_measures_the_repaired_build.py) with 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 <proof>' since hollow.py changed under them. Commit hollow.py, the proofs' validations and the tester history/state with a subject starting '763379e32e3b: build'. Any proof the pre-commit reseal door times out is resealed by hand with 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 2700 <proof>' and committed.

D5: SETTLED: Nothing else changes. cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py's _hollow_reverts (line 507) mirrors the old _classify for the UNRAN sieve and stays as it is: a proofs/ module an instrument imports is in the instrument set and never reverted, so the narrower skip cannot make an instrument go UNRAN, and RULE 1 keeps another component's file out of this build. clearance.hollow_lacks is unchanged; a run that measures nothing is still red. 580ad3b46cd0's re-crossing (its FIXME answer cites this ticket once PROVED) and 9c46e187f2de (its build changed only its own instrument, which stays skipped) are not part of this ticket.
